PackSpecsLoadingManualsParts ListProduct OverviewOur M12™ REDLITHIUM™ CP2.0 Compact Battery 2-Pack features superior pack construction, electronics, and performance. The rechargeable battery offers you 2.0 amp-hours of runtime. Each battery pack is durably built for heavy-duty use, runs cooler, and performs in climates below 0°F/-18°C. Its compact, lightweight design allows you to work in tight workspaces and reduces fatigue. Built-in REDLINK™ Intelligence protects the battery from overloads, preventing damage to your cordless power tools in heavy-duty situations, while discharge protection safeguards the cell. An integrated temperature management system and individual cell monitoring help to maximize your battery's life. Compatible with all products in the M12™ Cordless tool system, REDLITHIUM™ battery packs will provide unmatched runtime, performance, and durability for the professional tradesman.All-weather performance: Delivers fade-free power in extreme jobsite conditionsBest-in-class construction: Offers long-lasting performance and durabilityREDLINK™ Intelligence: Provides optimized performance and overload protection using total system communication between tool, battery and chargerVersatility: Powers all Milwaukee M12™ cordless power toolsReviewsAdditional ResourcesManualsWarrantyParts ListFix My ToolExplore the systems48-11-2422M12™ REDLITHIUM™ CP2.0 Battery Two PackShare© 2026 by Milwaukee Tool.
